debug-tab: stale script, a timing race in the script not the code. The phone case waits up to 15 s for llm=ok; the 1920 case read the lights after a fixed 1.2 s, but the stub answer only arrives on the next 1.5 s file poll. Fixed by waiting for the light the same way (a wait for the event, not a retry). Needs real Whisper at 127.0.0.1:8178; my private fence now lets only that through. Green.

reconnect: stale script, four causes, no code bug. (1) shown() read a missing .dev-link as shown, but dev/Socket/Link.js (2026-11-01) builds the banner only after its 8 s grace. (2) The Dictate page asks Servex for /cards and /api/agents; the fence answers with an object and work.js threw cardRows.filter, so the script stubs both. (3) The Servex-back phase used route.fallback(), which under the fence is a 502 forever; it now serves an opening stream itself. (4) WhisperLog.automated() drops connection lines from scripted browsers, as its own doc says reconnect.mjs must set window.$WHISPER_LOG_FORCE. Green through the fenced runner recipe. Side note: work.js assumes cards() is an array or null, so any non-array answer from Servex breaks the page; not mine, worth a line to core/Page.

stall: stale script. The stub counted every POST session/say, but Recite now files a diagnostic say (kind: error, 'recite: sheet follows ...') as the first one, so the 'hang the first say' scenario hung a diagnostic and every real prompt went out fine (nothing was ever stalled, so no not-sent mark). Fixed by counting and stalling only posts with no kind, as settings.mjs does. No code change. Green with the fence recipe.

dictation-bar race: the stub pushed EVERY POST session/say into `said`, and the loop waits for said.length >= 3. Recite files a diagnostic say (kind: error, 'recite: sheet follows ...') once the sheet opens, at a moment that varies with load, so the loop sometimes ended after only 2 real sentences plus the diagnostic, and the later checks (type box, pause label, jumps) ran against a thread with fewer bubbles. Fix: count only posts with no kind (no retry, no longer timeout). Seen in the first run before the fix: sentences[0] was the diagnostic. Not reproduced as a red in 6 idle/3x-load runs before the fix, so the earlier red is explained by this race but not individually proven; after the fix 3 of 3 under 3x parallel load pass.
